create_Flux2KleinPipeline: create a Flux2KleinPipeline instance from a model path and server arguments for image generation
build_Flux2Pipeline_stages: build a Flux2Pipeline with text encoding, denoising, and decoding stages for text-to-image generation
run_Flux2Pipeline_forward: run the Flux2Pipeline forward pass on a request batch to generate images
set_Flux2Pipeline_lora: set a LoRA adapter on the Flux2Pipeline to modify the diffusion transformer weights
compute_empirical_mu: compute the empirical mu value for inference steps based on image sequence length
